zh.summary: 把一項需求變更串到規格、設計、程式與驗證，保留修改理由及原本仍要成立的承諾。
objectives: 以小步變更說明本課規格驅動開發的工作方式。
為新增必要欄位盤點規格、介面、輸出及測試影響。
區分要求改變、實作修正與尚未驗證的結果。

readingGuide.goal: 以小步變更說明本課規格驅動開發的工作方式。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器、spec.md及工作坊reference/檔案，可先只閱讀；不需實際新增第四欄。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 spec.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: 一份可審查的C-02變更計畫，能由候選要求追到受影響檔案與待驗情境。

sections.heading: 每次需求改變，都要維持一致
paragraphs: 軟體每次需求改變，都要確認規格、畫面、資料、程式和測試仍然一致。SDD（Spec-Driven Development，規格驅動開發）在本課指：以可討論、可版本控制的規格引導變更，再用實作與證據回頭核對。
規格記下為什麼修改、哪些地方應該修改、實際改了什麼，以及如何證明修改正確。這是課程的工作定義；不同工具的流程與名稱各有差異。文件的用途是支援討論、追溯與核對，篇幅依變更需要決定。

sections.heading: 一、從餐廳理解變更的影響
paragraphs: 假設你經營連鎖餐廳，因顧客需求，決定把一道雞肉料理改成不含花生的版本。廚師不再加花生之後，還有哪些環節需要同步？

- 菜單上的過敏原標示是否更新？
- 採購清單是否需要調整？
- 廚師使用的食譜是否改變？
- 外送平台的餐點資訊是否正確？
- 廚房是否可能發生交叉接觸？
- 出餐前要怎麼確認符合新要求？
如果只口頭通知廚師，其他環節仍可能沿用舊資料。這個類比說明依賴關係如何擴散：一次變更要沿著相關資訊與作業逐一檢查。此處只用來理解軟體變更，不提供餐飲過敏原安全認證或操作程序。

sections.heading: 二、SDD 的核心工作流程
paragraphs: 先記錄變更理由與核准狀態，再把新規則及必須保留的舊規則寫清楚。依影響分析實作，執行新情境與受影響的回歸測試，最後以證據作接受、修正或暫緩的決定。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜SDD 的五步變更流程
blocks.description: 這是反覆迭代的流程，不代表每一步只能執行一次。

items.title: 需求變更（Change Request）
items.body: 為什麼要改？誰提出？是否已核准？

items.title: 更新規格（Specification）
items.body: 新的規則是什麼？原有規則哪些不能破壞？

items.title: 影響分析與實作（Implementation）
items.body: 修改哪些畫面、資料、程式與文件？

items.title: 測試與驗證（Verification）
items.body: 新功能正確嗎？舊功能有沒有被破壞？

items.title: 審查、決策與留下證據
items.body: 接受、修正或暫緩；必要時回到前面重新確認

paragraphs: ### 三個一定要理解的名詞
Specification（規格）：軟體應該遵守的規則。好比食譜寫明每份餐點必須使用哪些食材。
Diff（差異）：修改前後的差別。把新舊食譜並排，便能檢查具體改了哪些內容；程式與文件也用差異檢視審查。
Regression Testing（回歸測試）：修改後重新確認原本正常的功能沒有被破壞。例如改了付款功能，仍要檢查退款與訂單查詢。

sections.heading: 三、案例：從三個必填欄位增加第四個
paragraphs: 合成情境 C-02：公司的收件系統原有三個必要欄位，現在有人提議增加「收件批次代號」。如果只交代 AI Coding Agent「幫我新增一個收件批次代號的輸入框」，畫面可能很快出現欄位，但其他規則仍沿用三欄版本。
Change Impact Analysis（變更影響分析）先盤點可能受影響的地方。一項變更不一定修改所有檔案，卻需要逐項檢查相依範圍。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜第四個欄位的變更影響
rows: 第四欄是否必填？允許哪些值？舊資料怎麼處理？
欄位放哪裡？沒有填寫要怎麼提示？
少了第四欄是否禁止完成？
匯出的 JSON、CSV 或文件是否加入新欄位？
修改輸入後，舊的驗證結果是否需要失效？
新增哪些案例？原本哪些測試要重新執行？

paragraphs: ### 把需求寫成可以檢驗的規格
假設負責人確認：「新的收件資料必須填寫第四欄，否則不得完整匯出。」可以沿用 M05-03 的 Given / When / Then：Given 交代起始條件，When 指出動作，Then 描述可觀察的結果。

blocks.heading: 情境一｜缺少第四欄
paragraphs: 以下是候選規格與紀錄範本，尚未實作。
blocks.code:
Scenario: 缺少收件批次代號

Given 使用者已填寫原本三個必要欄位
And 收件批次代號為空白

When 使用者執行資料驗證

Then 系統應顯示缺少收件批次代號
And 系統不得提供完整資料匯出

blocks.heading: 情境二｜驗證後修改輸入
paragraphs: 以下是候選規格與紀錄範本，尚未實作。
blocks.code:
Scenario: 驗證完成後修改輸入資料

Given 四個必要欄位均已通過驗證

When 使用者清空收件批次代號

Then 原本的驗證結果應失效
And 系統不得沿用舊結果完成匯出

paragraphs: 第一個情境確認新規則，第二個情境防止沿用過期結果。這些仍是候選規格；採用前要確認有效值、舊資料政策與輸出契約。
本課保留三欄參考解答，沒有實作第四欄，也沒有真實單位核准的證據。若課堂暫用既有字串規則，要把它記成教學決定，並核對輸出允許清單、空白與缺漏規則。

sections.heading: 四、人類與 AI Agent 如何分工
paragraphs: 工程師可能只記得改程式而漏掉文件。AI Coding Agent 可以很快改動大量檔案；若只要求「支援第四個欄位」，它可能自行猜測必填性、格式或資料庫修改。這些猜測需要需求負責人確認。

blocks.caption: 表 2｜可審查的人機分工
rows: 盤點可能受影響的檔案
修改程式、介面及相關文件
提供可檢查的修改與驗證證據

paragraphs: 從需求找到設計、實作與測試，也從測試或實作回頭找到需求，稱為雙向可追溯性（Bidirectional Traceability）。NASA SWE-052 說明需求、設計、程式及驗證之間的追溯關係；本課借用這個原理，不宣稱合成案例已符合 NASA 的專案要求。
為每條需求配置穩定代號，再連到情境、檔案與實際結果。連結存在只證明建立了關係；審查時仍需打開證據，核對版本、範圍及結果。

sections.heading: 五、把相同思考用到不同產業
paragraphs: 以下三個合成情境都從需求沿依賴關係追查；實際採用的規則由各單位確認。
### 醫院：新增過敏史必填欄位
需要檢查舊病歷如何顯示、缺漏是否阻擋送出、誰有權修改，以及相關提醒和測試是否同步。輸入框只涵蓋介面的一部分。
### 物流：新增特殊配送標記
逐項檢查訂單頁面、倉儲系統、司機端、標籤列印和異常配送處理。資料表新增欄位後，仍需確認各端如何讀取與呈現。
### 銀行：新增貸款審核條件
除了判斷邏輯，還需核對原有客戶案件、審批流程、拒絕原因及稽核紀錄受到的影響。需求改變往往沿著系統依賴擴散。

sections.heading: 六、最容易犯的三個錯誤
paragraphs: 第一，只改程式，規格仍停在舊版。下一位工程師或 AI Agent 可能依舊文件再把行為改回去，因此應同步維護已確認的規格。
第二，為了讓測試通過，反過來改要求。若已確認缺少必填資料不得匯出，程式卻仍可匯出，應修正實作偏離；真正業務需求改變時，另以明確提案修訂承諾並重新審查。
第三，把全部綠燈當成完成。測試可能漏掉情境，或預期結果被改錯；要拿真實規格逐條核對測試。新增第四欄後，原完整資料可能成為缺件，應區分需要更新的測試資料與刻意保留的舊資料負向案例。

sections.heading: 七、從一份 Markdown 開始
paragraphs: 每次變更先留下目的、狀態、未知規則、可觀察行為、影響範圍、驗證計畫、實作證據與最終決策。一份 Markdown 就能開始，後續再依協作需求擴充。

blocks.heading: 最小 SDD 變更紀錄
paragraphs: 以下是候選規格與紀錄範本，尚未實作。
blocks.code:
# CHANGE-001：新增必要欄位

## 目的
為什麼提出這項變更？

## 狀態
候選／已核准／實作中／已驗證

## 待確認事項
哪些規則還不能自行假設？

## 規格
修改後應出現哪些可觀察行為？

## 影響範圍
哪些畫面、資料、程式和測試可能受影響？

## 驗證計畫
如何確認新需求與既有功能？

## 實作證據
修改的檔案、Commit、Diff、測試結果

## 最終決策
接受、退回修正或暫緩

paragraphs: 這份紀錄可逐步擴展成需求追溯矩陣（Requirements Traceability Matrix），讓每條需求連到實作、測試及驗證證據。多人協作或版本增多時，可評估 OpenSpec；工具支援文件流程，需求確認與驗證責任仍由負責角色承擔。
現有參考專案的 spec.md、wireframe.svg、rules.py、app.py、tests/test_rules.py 與 tests/test_app.py 可作影響盤點。寫下計畫不表示這些檔案已改成四欄，也不能填入不存在的測試名稱冒充通過證據。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器、spec.md及工作坊reference/檔案，可先只閱讀；不需實際新增第四欄。
steps: 為C-02寫目的、未決規則與確認角色，標為候選提案。
逐一盤點規格、線框稿、規則、介面、輸出與測試影響，補一條缺少第四欄的候選負向情境。
比較哪些既有資料需更新、哪些應保留為舊資料負向案例，將未執行的驗證計畫留在變更紀錄。
exercise.expected: 一份可審查的C-02變更計畫，能由候選要求追到受影響檔案與待驗情境。
exercise.check: 沒有把三欄參考解答誤寫為已修改；能區分需求變更與為求測試通過而改要求。
exercise.cleanup: 保留原始參考專案，紙上計畫使用合成資料；未授權或未決項目不自行啟用。

openChecks.prompt: 概念判斷｜某位工程師發現必填檢查沒有生效，為了讓測試通過，直接把規格的「必填」改成「選填」。這是正常需求變更還是掩蓋實作錯誤？為什麼？
answer: 這是掩蓋實作錯誤。已確認的必填規則仍有效，應修正檢查並驗證；若業務需求確實變更，另提案、核准並檢查影響。

openChecks.prompt: 情境分析｜電商把「訂單滿 1,000 元免運費」改成「滿 1,500 元免運費」。除了公式，至少提出四個必須同步檢查的系統或流程。
answer: 可檢查商品頁與活動文案、購物車門檻提示、結帳計價與金額邊界測試、客服與退款流程、優惠疊加規則及訂單輸出。列出影響後確認實際政策，並測試 1,000、1,499、1,500 元等邊界。

openChecks.prompt: AI 協作實務｜Agent 回報「已完成修改，所有測試均通過」。接受前要哪些證據？如何判斷測試涵蓋需求？
answer: 要求已核准規格、範圍與 Diff、受影響檔案、實際命令／版本／結果、負向與回歸案例及未驗事項。逐條將需求連到測試斷言，再檢查斷言與可觀察行為；綠燈本身無法證明測試完整。

en.summary: Connect a requirement change to specification, design, code and verification, retaining its reason and commitments that must still hold.
objectives: Explain the course’s spec-driven workflow through a small change.
Identify specification, interface, output and test impacts of an added required field.
Distinguish changed requirements, implementation corrections and unverified results.

readingGuide.goal: Explain the course’s spec-driven workflow through a small change.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor, spec.md and workshop reference/ files, initially read-only; no fourth-field implementation is required.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand spec.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A reviewable C-02 change plan connecting a candidate requirement to affected files and pending scenarios.

sections.heading: Keep Every Change Consistent
paragraphs: Whenever requirements change, check that specifications, screens, data, code and tests remain consistent. In this course, Spec-Driven Development (SDD) means guiding changes with discussable, version-controlled specifications and checking them against implementation and evidence.

A specification records why a change is needed, what should change, what actually changed and how correctness will be demonstrated. This is a course working definition; tools have different workflows and names. Document length follows the needs of discussion, traceability and review.

sections.heading: 1. Understand Impact Through a Restaurant
paragraphs: Imagine a restaurant chain changing a chicken dish to a peanut-free version at customers’ request. After the cook stops adding peanuts, which other parts need attention?

- Has the menu’s allergen labeling changed?
- Does the purchasing list need updating?
- Has the cooking recipe changed?
- Is the delivery platform’s description correct?
- Could cross-contact occur in the kitchen?
- How will the new requirement be checked before serving?

An oral instruction to the cook may leave other processes using old information. This analogy shows how dependencies propagate: follow relevant information and operations through each affected area. It illustrates software change and supplies no food-allergen safety certification or operating procedure.

sections.heading: 2. The Core SDD Workflow
paragraphs: Record the reason and approval state, then specify new rules and retained commitments. Implement according to impact analysis, test new scenarios and affected regressions, and use evidence to accept, revise or defer.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Five Steps for an SDD Change
blocks.description: This is an iterative process; each step may be revisited.

items.title: Change Request
items.body: Why change? Who proposed it? Has it been approved?

items.title: Specification
items.body: What are the new rules? Which existing rules must remain intact?

items.title: Impact Analysis and Implementation
items.body: Which screens, data, code and documents change?

items.title: Testing and Verification
items.body: Does the new behavior work? Do existing features still work?

items.title: Review, Decision and Evidence
items.body: Accept, revise or defer; return to earlier steps when necessary.

paragraphs: ### Three terms to understand
Specification: rules the software must follow, like a recipe listing required ingredients for each serving.
Diff: the difference between before and after. Comparing old and new recipes reveals specific edits; code and document reviews similarly inspect diffs.
Regression Testing: recheck previously working behavior after a change. A payment change may require checking refunds and order lookup as well.

sections.heading: 3. Case: Add a Fourth Required Field
paragraphs: Synthetic proposal C-02 adds an “intake batch code” to a company’s three-required-field intake system. Asking an AI Coding Agent only to add the input may quickly produce a visible field while other rules still assume three fields.
Change Impact Analysis identifies potentially affected areas first. One change need not modify every file, but it requires checking all relevant dependencies.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Impact of the Fourth Field
rows: Is it required? Which values are valid? How is old data handled?
Where is it placed? What guidance appears when it is missing?
Does a missing fourth field block completion?
Does exported JSON, CSV or a document include the field?
Does editing input invalidate previous validation?
Which new cases and existing regression tests are needed?

paragraphs: ### Turn the request into testable specifications

Suppose the owner confirms that new intake records need the fourth field before complete export. Reuse M05-03’s Given / When / Then: Given defines starting conditions, When names the action, and Then specifies observable outcomes.

blocks.heading: Scenario 1 | Missing fourth field
paragraphs: The Chinese-language block is a candidate specification or record template, not an implemented change.
blocks.code:
Scenario: 缺少收件批次代號

Given 使用者已填寫原本三個必要欄位
And 收件批次代號為空白

When 使用者執行資料驗證

Then 系統應顯示缺少收件批次代號
And 系統不得提供完整資料匯出

blocks.heading: Scenario 2 | Edit after validation
paragraphs: The Chinese-language block is a candidate specification or record template, not an implemented change.
blocks.code:
Scenario: 驗證完成後修改輸入資料

Given 四個必要欄位均已通過驗證

When 使用者清空收件批次代號

Then 原本的驗證結果應失效
And 系統不得沿用舊結果完成匯出

paragraphs: The first Chinese-language scenario says: given the original three fields are filled and the batch code is blank, when validation runs, report the missing batch code and prohibit complete export. The second says: given all four fields passed validation, when the batch code is cleared, invalidate the prior result and prohibit export based on it. Both remain candidate specifications; valid values, old-data policy and output contracts require confirmation.

The three-field reference stays intact. This lesson implements no fourth field and has no actual organizational approval. If a class provisionally reuses existing string rules, record that teaching decision and review the output allowlist, whitespace and missing-input rules.

sections.heading: 4. Divide Responsibility Between People and Agents
paragraphs: Engineers can change code and overlook documents. AI Coding Agents can change many files quickly; an instruction to “support the fourth field” may lead an agent to guess required status, format or database changes. The requirements owner must resolve those guesses.

blocks.caption: Table 2 | Reviewable Human–Agent Responsibilities
headers: An AI agent can assist with
rows: Provide inspectable changes and verification evidence

paragraphs: Bidirectional Traceability means following requirements to design, implementation and tests, and following tests or implementation back to requirements. NASA SWE-052 describes links among requirements, design, code and verification. This course applies the principle without claiming the synthetic case meets NASA project requirements.
Give requirements stable IDs and link them to scenarios, files and actual results. A link establishes a relationship; reviewers must still open the evidence and check version, scope and result.

sections.heading: 5. Apply the Same Reasoning Across Industries
paragraphs: These three synthetic cases follow dependencies from a changed requirement. Each organization confirms its actual rules.
### Hospital: require allergy history
Check how old records appear, whether missing history blocks submission, who can edit it, and whether related alerts and tests are updated. An input box covers only part of the interface.
### Logistics: add a special-delivery marker
Inspect the order page, warehouse system, driver app, label printing and delivery-exception handling. After adding a database field, confirm how every consumer reads and presents it.
### Bank: add a loan-review condition
Beyond decision logic, inspect existing customer cases, approval workflow, rejection reasons and audit records. Requirement changes often propagate through system dependencies.

sections.heading: 6. Three Common Mistakes
paragraphs: First, code changes while the specification stays old. The next engineer or agent may follow the old document and undo the intended behavior, so maintain confirmed specifications alongside implementation.

Second, requirements are rewritten merely to pass tests. If confirmed rules prohibit complete export with missing required data but code permits it, correct implementation drift. Actual business changes need explicit proposals, revised commitments and renewed review.

Third, all-green tests are treated as completion. Tests may omit scenarios or have incorrect expected results; compare them with actual specifications. A fourth field can make formerly complete fixtures incomplete: distinguish fixtures to update from deliberately retained old-data negative cases.

sections.heading: 7. Start with One Markdown File
paragraphs: For each change, record purpose, status, unresolved rules, observable behavior, impact, verification plan, implementation evidence and final decision. Start with Markdown and expand when collaboration requires it.

# CHANGE-001：新增必要欄位

## 目的
為什麼提出這項變更？

## 狀態
候選／已核准／實作中／已驗證

## 待確認事項
哪些規則還不能自行假設？

## 規格
修改後應出現哪些可觀察行為？

## 影響範圍
哪些畫面、資料、程式和測試可能受影響？

## 驗證計畫
如何確認新需求與既有功能？

## 實作證據
修改的檔案、Commit、Diff、測試結果

## 最終決策
接受、退回修正或暫緩

paragraphs: The Chinese template’s eight headings are purpose, state (candidate / approved / implementing / verified), unresolved questions, observable specification, affected screens/data/code/tests, verification plan, files/commit/diff/test evidence, and acceptance/revision/deferral decision. It can grow into a Requirements Traceability Matrix linking each requirement to implementation, tests and evidence. For more collaborators or versions, evaluate OpenSpec; tooling supports the document workflow while responsible people retain requirements and verification decisions.

The reference project’s spec.md, wireframe.svg, rules.py, app.py, tests/test_rules.py and tests/test_app.py support impact review. A plan does not establish fourth-field edits or permit invented test names to stand in for passing evidence.

exercise.environment: A text editor, spec.md and workshop reference/ files, initially read-only; no fourth-field implementation is required.
steps: Write C-02 purpose, unresolved rules and confirming role, labeling it a candidate proposal.
Review specification, wireframe, rules, interface, output and test impacts; add a proposed negative case missing the fourth field.
Distinguish data to update from old-data negative cases to retain. Keep unexecuted verification plans in the change record.
exercise.expected: A reviewable C-02 change plan connecting a candidate requirement to affected files and pending scenarios.
exercise.check: Do not describe the three-field reference as modified. Distinguish a real requirement change from weakening commitments to make tests pass.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the original reference project. Use synthetic data and do not activate undecided or unauthorized work.

openChecks.prompt: Concept judgment｜An engineer makes a broken required-field check pass by changing the specification from required to optional. Is this a legitimate requirement change or concealment of a bug, and why?
answer: It conceals an implementation error. The confirmed rule remains valid: repair and verify the check. A genuine business change needs a separate proposal, approval and impact review.

openChecks.prompt: Scenario analysis｜An online shop raises free shipping from orders of 1,000 to 1,500 currency units. Besides the formula, name at least four systems or workflows to inspect.
answer: Inspect product/promotional copy, cart threshold guidance, checkout and amount-boundary tests, support/refund procedures, discount combinations and order output. Confirm actual policy and test boundaries such as 1,000, 1,499 and 1,500.

openChecks.prompt: AI collaboration｜An agent reports “changes complete; all tests pass.” What evidence do you require before acceptance, and how do you check requirements coverage?
answer: Request approved specifications, scope/diff, affected files, actual commands/versions/results, negative/regression cases and unverified items. Map every requirement to assertions, then compare assertions with observable behavior; green results alone cannot prove coverage.

zh.prompt: 本章SDD最主要維持哪種關係？
options: 只要規格字數越多越好
規格、實作與驗證隨變更保持可追溯的一致
先把所有功能一次產生
文件與測試可以互不相關
rationales: 數量不能代替可驗收性。
變更目的、行為與證據需要互相核對。
不符合小步修正與審查。
會讓偏離難以被發現。

en.prompt: What relationship does this lesson’s SDD maintain?
options: More specification words are always better.
Specifications, implementation and verification stay traceably consistent through changes.
Generate all features at once.
Documentation and tests need not relate.
rationales: Volume cannot replace verifiability.
Purpose, behavior and evidence must be checked together.
This bypasses small changes and review.
Drift becomes difficult to detect.

zh.prompt: 新增第四個必要欄位，最需要避免什麼？
options: 保留變更理由
補新欄缺漏案例
檢查輸出允許清單
只加輸入框，卻未更新規則、完成文案與測試
rationales: 理由有助追溯。
負向情境支援驗收。
輸出契約也可能受影響。
介面出現欄位不代表規格與驗證已同步。

en.prompt: What should be avoided when adding a fourth required field?
options: Retain the change reason.
Add a missing-new-field case.
Inspect the output allowlist.
Add only an input without updating rules, completion wording and tests.
rationales: Reasons support traceability.
Negative scenarios support acceptance.
The output contract may also change.
A visible field does not synchronize specification and verification.

zh.prompt: 程式違反已確認的缺件匯出規則時，應如何處理？
options: 直接把規格改成允許缺件
刪掉失敗測試
先辨識實作偏離並修正；真正需求改變另走明確提案與審查
只更新README寫已完成
rationales: 不能用改承諾掩蓋程式錯誤。
失敗可能指出真實偏離，不應為綠燈刪除。
分開問題類型，才能保留規則與變更責任。
文件宣告不會改變實際行為。

en.prompt: Code violates a confirmed missing-input export rule. What next?
options: Rewrite the spec to permit missing data.
Delete the failing test.
Identify and correct implementation drift; actual requirement changes need separate explicit proposals and review.
Only update README to say complete.
rationales: Changing commitments must not conceal code errors.
Failure may reveal real drift; do not remove it for green results.
Separating problem types retains rule and change responsibility.
A documentation claim does not change behavior.
